query: I just finished binging the last season of my favorite drama yesterday, the ending was so unexpected that I stayed up till 2 a.m. discussing it with my friend. This morning when I was walking my dog, he even ran after a squirrel and dragged me halfway across the park, I still have a little grass stain on my sleeve. The coffee shop down my street just launched a new matcha latte with honey boba, I tried it on the way home and it’s way sweeter than I thought it would be. Anyway, I need to handle a couple of issues with my delivered orders: for order #W7553978, I want to return items 4545791457, 3098764622 and 1631806422, and refund the amount to credit_card_5902940; for order #W3239882, I want to exchange item 9494281769 for item 7609274509, with any additional payment or refund also going through credit_card_5902940, thanks.
